mapper.select: SELECT block_number FROM block_checkpoint WHERE chain_id = #{chainId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO block_checkpoint (chain_id, block_number, block_hash, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{chainId}, #{blockNumber}, #{blockHash}, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON CONFLICT (chain_id) DO UPDATE SET block_number = EXCLUDED.block_number, block_hash = EXCLUDED.block_hash, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = NOW() WHERE block_checkpoint.block_number < EXCLUDED.block_number
